newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe surges again after recent dive.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe surges again after recent dive.

text.p: Polish debt-ridden builder Espebepe SA rose 10 percent to 4.4 zlotys, extending Monday's 8.1-percent surge after last week's steep fall as speculators played on the firm's uncertain future, traders said.
The stock fell 46.4 percent last week.
"The rises show the faith of some investors that the firm will be able to continue to exist," one trader said.
Earlier this month Espebepe, which has 75 million zlotys in debts and faces the risk of bankruptcy, had a creditors meeting postponed to April 14.
The stock did not trade after price fixing on Tuesday due to excess demand, which traders said could signal another big gain on Friday.
